Let me look at the commit `a01a139a` "Pull in htscodecs bug fixes" and `90fef730` "More OSS-Fuzz detected fixes". Let me look at the htscodecs submodule update in these.

Actually, let me reconsider. The issue 42491972 is a heap-buffer-overflow READ 1 in `arith_uncompress_to`. Let me look at the actual fix. Let me look at the htscodecs commit `cf8eca1` which fixes "OSS fuzz 1-byte buffer read-overrun" (oss-fuzz 29792). But our issue is 42491972.

Let me look at the htslib commit that pulled in the fix for 42491972. Let me look at the git log around the time of the fix. The issue was reported Jan 21, 2021. Let me look at the htslib commits that update htscodecs around that time.
